caption: The free preview asks only for an email address, which GrapeLeads also uses for promotional offers. No card, password or phone number. The pop-up asked for it again before each of our 3 searches.

Confirm Order before our first search, roofers in Dallas: one credit for the search plus one per result, and no estimate of what the results will cost. That search found 0 leads and still took 1 credit.
Search 2: hair salons in San Francisco without a website and with a phone number. No results email came within 25 minutes, not even in junk, and the page showed no error or status.
Credits come in one-time packs: Freelancer $28 for 50, Startup $55 for 100 and Agency $127 for 250, paid through Stripe. The /pricing page itself gave Page not found. We bought nothing.
Before search 3 the counter read 18, so the hair salon search had used a credit for nothing. This landscaping search returned 11 leads for 12 credits, and we counted 6 of them as usable.
